title: Witkoff and Kushner Meet Zelensky in Kyiv, Push for Trilateral Talks After Moscow Visit
detail: US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner arrived in Kyiv on September 6, a day after their three-hour meeting with Vladimir Putin in Moscow, for their first official visit to the Ukrainian capital. They met twice with President Volodymyr Zelensky and senior Ukrainian officials, with national security advisers from the UK, France, and Germany joining a third session. Zelensky gave the envoys a tour of the bomb-damaged St. Sophia's Cathedral. Witkoff described the talks as 'substantive' and expressed confidence in a 'good resolution,' with both envoys pushing for a return to trilateral US-Russia-Ukraine talks and stressing they wanted a breakthrough before winter. Russia and Ukraine's reciprocal 72-hour pause on strikes against Moscow and Kyiv, agreed to accommodate the shuttle diplomacy, remained in effect during the visit.

title: Ukrainian Drones Strike Ryazan Oil Refinery in Russia, Setting Isomerization Unit Ablaze
detail: Ukrainian long-range drones struck Russia's Ryazan oil refinery — one of Rosneft's largest facilities, with a processing capacity of roughly 17 million tonnes of crude per year — early on September 6, hitting the Isomal-2-LIN-800 isomerization unit and sparking a fire. Ukraine's General Staff confirmed the strike. The unit converts low-octane petroleum fractions into high-octane, Euro-5-compliant blending components; Ukrainian forces had previously knocked out two of the refinery's four crude processing units earlier in 2026. The strike is part of Ukraine's sustained year-long campaign against Russian refineries, pipelines, and export terminals aimed at cutting the fuel supplies and oil revenue funding Russia's war effort. Additional drone strikes were reported the same night against Rostov Oblast air defenses and other Russian cities.

media.caption: Fire at the Ryazan oil refinery's isomerization unit after a Ukrainian drone strike, September 6, 2026
